prompt:
ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down onto the object from above. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical outside faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game sprite for an air-dropped military cargo bundle, seen from directly above as it hangs under its parachute. Images 1 and 2 are our approved pieces from the same game: match their outline weight, shading, strap and canvas colours and finish only. Do NOT copy their shapes.

Square canvas. The bundle is square, filling about 75 percent of the canvas, centred, on a plain pure white background.

The bundle seen from above: a squarish load wrapped in a heavy olive-drab canvas cover, its top bulging a little with a few soft folds; four wide tan cargo straps crossing it, two running top to bottom and two running left to right, with small steel buckles; the straps meeting at one round steel ring in the very centre where the parachute hooks on; and the corners of a pale plywood skid board just showing beneath the canvas at the four corners.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, muted olive, tan and steel colours, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No text, letters, numbers, stencils, logos, people, parachute, canopy, lines or ropes going off the bundle. No ground beyond the object, no shadow outside it, no perspective, no tilt.
